bio.jane/contract.question: Which authoritative databases are available, and what does each cover?

description: The authoritative databases available, with what each one covers, whether it is reachable from the browser, and any license or coverage caveat. Call this before searching if unsure which source answers a question.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

domain.description: restrict to one subject area (all areas when unset).

name: list_databases

count.description: how many authorities the filter left

sources.description: every authority in the requested domain: its id, what it covers, its measured browser transport verdict, and any license or coverage caveat
